lastError.description: Why the last delivery failed; null when it worked

hmacRequired.description: Requests must carry an HMAC signature (spec §8.2)

publicKey.description: RSA public key (PEM) responses are encrypted to

responseEncrypt.description: Responses are encrypted to the client's public key (spec §8.3)

signingKey.description: Shown once when issued; store it now

details.description: What differs, e.g. spec.task or publish

items.description: What differs, e.g. spec.task or publish

additionalProperties.description: Logical datasource name in configuration files → datasource name in this workspace

bindings.description: Logical datasource name in configuration files → datasource name in this workspace

digest.description: Identifies this plan; pass it to apply to refuse a workspace that changed since

ownerUserId.description: First owner; defaults to the caller

attribute.description: For kind row_filter: the service account attribute holding the allowed value(s)

exemptServiceAccounts.description: Service accounts this policy does not apply to

items.description: Service accounts this policy does not apply to

passwordEnv.description: The env: or vault: reference when the password comes from outside

passwordSecret.description: The managed secret holding the password, when it is one

sunset.description: When the endpoint will stop answering (Sunset header)

rules.description: Checks on the bound parameters, run before the query (spec §13.1)

params.description: Parameter values by name; page and size select a page

serviceAccountId.description: Call as this service account (grants, rules and data policies apply); null runs like preview

detail.description: Method and path, for an endpoint

LastTest.description: Last connection test; null when never tested since the settings changed

ratePerMinute.description: Calls per minute across all callers; null = unlimited

streamMaxRows.description: Most rows a streamed response returns; null = maxRows

usedBy.description: Datasources and alert channels that use it

workspace.description: Workspace slug; null only for system_admin

path.description: Defaults to v<N>/… from the current path

Output.description: How rows are shaped in the response (spec §9.2)

max.description: Numbers: largest value; text: longest length

min.description: Numbers: smallest value; text: shortest length

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match

value.description: Full-mode scripts: what the script returned

secretEnv.description: env: references are shown; sealed values are not

additionalProperties.description: Logical datasource name in configuration files → datasource name here

bindings.description: Logical datasource name in configuration files → datasource name here

Rule.description: Checks on the bound parameters, run before the query (spec §13.1)

password.description: Plain password (stored encrypted) or env:NAME; omit to keep the stored one

port.description: Default port of the dialect when empty

secret.description: Plain secret (sealed on save) or an env:NAME reference; omit to keep

attributes.description: Replaces all attributes; null keeps them

SecretUse.description: Datasources and alert channels that use it

attributes.description: Facts about the caller that row filters read (spec §12.2), values are strings, numbers, booleans or lists of them

slowestEndpoints.description: Endpoints with the highest p95 latency, at least 5 calls each

nodes.description: Workflow tasks: the nodes of the graph (spec §6.1)

output.description: Workflow tasks: the node whose result is the answer; the last node when empty

existingId.description: Use this saved datasource's password when settings.password is empty

TopEndpoint.description: Endpoints with the highest p95 latency, at least 5 calls each

result.description: sql nodes: what the node's result is; list by default

source.description: script nodes: a full-mode Groovy script

when.description: Run only when this expression holds, e.g. user != null

WorkflowNode.description: Workflow tasks: the nodes of the graph (spec §6.1)
